task: Add a no-key demo path end to end: a demo transcription source that replays a scripted meeting and a demo summarizer that trims real recent speech, so the whole transcript -> summarize -> display pipeline can be rehearsed with no microphone and no API key

public/services/transcription/demo.js.summary: createDemoTranscriptionDriver({onEvent, onStatus, setTimeoutFn, clearTimeoutFn, script}) -- third transcription driver, same interface as browser/openai (id, label, isAvailable, start, stop, setMode). isAvailable() is unconditionally true: it depends on no browser API, no key and no network. Replays DEMO_SCRIPT (25 utterances of ordinary church-meeting speech, ~2 minutes) emitting several 'partial' events then one 'final' per utterance, all scheduled through the injected timer so tests are deterministic. Exports DEMO_SCRIPT.

public/services/summarization/demo.js.summary: createDemoSummarizer(deps) -- third summarizer, same {line} / {line: ''} contract as openai/claude. Deterministic LOCAL SELECTION, not generation: picks the most recent complete sentence from recentTranscript, strips filler openers, truncates on a word boundary at 72 chars, and returns the empty-line result when the candidate is already in visibleLines or there is nothing new. It never emits words that were not said -- that is the invariant that makes it safe to put on a church wall.

public/services/registry.js.summary: Added 'demo' cases to both createTranscriptionDriver and createSummarizationDriver.

public/services/catalog.js.summary: Added the demo entry to both listAvailableTranscriptionSources() and listAvailableSummarizationSources().

public/controller/view.js.summary: getProviderState now returns a configured, key-free state for kind/source demo (both kinds), and isSourceUnavailable short-circuits transcription 'demo' to available. The demo sources are therefore always offerable and never hidden by the provider-key gating.

public/controller/runtime.js.summary: ensureSelectedTranscriptionSourceExists no longer forces 'demo' back to 'browser' (demo can never become unavailable), and resolveAvailableSummarizationSource honours an explicit 'demo' choice. Deliberately NOT made the silent no-key fallback: falling back to demo would make a misconfigured service look like a working one.

public/index.html.summary: Added #transcriptionDemo and #summaryDemo provider option buttons (data-kind/data-source, picked up automatically by the [data-kind] querySelectorAll in start-app.js) and extended #transcriptionHint.

test/public/services/transcription/demo..summary: 6 tests: always-available, partial-then-final emission per utterance, no empty finals, stop() clears pending timers, restart-while-running, finished status.

test/public/services/summarization/demo..summary: 6 tests: shape/id/label, recent-sentence selection with filler skipping, word-boundary truncation, empty result when already visible or transcript empty, and a no-invented-words check.

test/public/services/catalog.test.js.summary: Both source-id lists now include 'demo'; added a test pinning that the demo transcription source advertises itself as needing no microphone or key.

flow_impact: New end-to-end path through the existing browser-transcription and summarize flows with no external dependency: demo driver -> handleTranscriptEvent -> transcript-bucket -> summarize loop -> demo summarizer -> addLine -> renderDisplay. Verified live in the browser with no API key: two display cards rendered from scripted speech.
